rows.requirement: Personal, user-controlled, traceable, portable lifelong external brain; not enterprise operations, IT operations, a plain note/task app, or a single AI chat surface.
rows.reason: V1 is local-first personal infrastructure with a Core Domain and interaction surfaces, not a team/operations architecture.

rows.requirement: Capture → save → organize → recover/today → confirm action → feedback; context recovery precedes generic automation.
rows.reason: The V1 MVP loop and verification chain preserve recovery, candidate action, explicit confirmation and feedback.

rows.requirement: Keep the 11 semantic objects plus Link; Source/Artifact separation, user-original protection, version/provenance, Feedback history, Authorization, Derivation and AuditEntry safeguards are not database-table claims.
rows.reason: V1 names the same core domain, positions it above Ports/Adapters, separates Source/Artifact and keeps derived data rebuildable; freeze_scope forbids Schema/API freeze.

rows.requirement: AI cannot overwrite originals or user-confirmed identity; revocation/delete blocks active use first, derivatives become stale/invalid and no export/restore revival is permitted.
rows.reason: V1 retains rebuildable derivations, authorization on consumption/execution paths, provenance metadata and a security boundary; V0 lifecycle details are explicitly retained by reconciliation V0-05 through V0-07.

rows.requirement: Six-dimensional authorization, visible AI identity/evidence, no automatic confirmation of fact/decision/action, feedback/retraction history, and explicit confirmation for high-impact execution.
rows.v1_anchor: V1 §2, §3 Orchestrator, §5 Model Port, §5 Agent Port, §6, §9
rows.reason: Model and Agent are separate Ports; Agent permissions follow a task, Model has no execution permission, important output enters Derivation, and Authorization coordinates important paths.

rows.requirement: Local authority, FTS-first/rebuildable derivatives, outbox/job separation, consumption recheck/fail-closed behavior, default-deny Tauri boundary and un-frozen implementation details continue.
rows.reason: All operative V0.1 norms are classified in reconciliation V0-01 through V0-16; none is silently deleted. Changed/delayed items are bounded and non-authoritative.

rows.requirement: Treat the accepted synthetic offline Tauri evidence as historical compatibility evidence only; do not claim it freezes a Runtime, IPC signature, schema, real filesystem or product capability.
rows.reason: V1 describes a target direction and explicitly leaves capabilities/signatures un-frozen; runtime_transition preserves P3 facts without retroactive reclassification.

rows.requirement: Person/Context/Memory/Global AI remain implementation candidates mapped to the existing core, not new frozen core objects or silent authorization expansion.
rows.reason: V1 has no competing second Core Domain; P3-128 remains Complete/Not Frozen and any engineering handoff remains separately authorized and currently paused.
V1 supports personal context recovery and user control without introducing enterprise, developer-tool or autonomous-agent product scope.

rows.requirement: No source, identity, version, confirmation, derivation, authorization or export/deletion semantic weakening.
rows.reason: Core-domain and lifecycle constraints are retained; V1 structure does not freeze tables or mappings.

rows.requirement: No AI permission, evidence, confirmation or high-risk execution expansion.
rows.reason: Orchestrator coordinates rather than owns data; Model is non-executing; Agent has task-bounded authorization; capability details remain unfrozen.

rows.requirement: A sustainable target architecture without premature microservices, cloud stack, vector DB, exact API/Schema or unproven Tauri capability freeze.
rows.reason: Modular monolith/ports-adapters is fixed while concrete implementation and future server choices are deferred; R-0040 remains conditional.

rows.requirement: User-value validation is not supplied by architecture documentation.
rows.reason: No real-user or real-data value claim is made. Gate 5 is explicitly recorded as not applicable to this static architecture-freeze candidate, not as a PASS.

counterexamples.attempt: Treat an AI-proposed Action as confirmed because Orchestrator selected it.
counterexamples.result: PASS: V1 §2 and Model/Agent boundaries preserve explicit user confirmation.

counterexamples.attempt: Expose a stale/vector/index hit without checking current authorization, version, tombstone or evidence.
counterexamples.result: PASS: V0-05/V0-06 are retained and V1 Search Port requires current-state recheck.

counterexamples.attempt: Promote P3-126's three IPC or SQLite fixture into frozen V1 API/Schema.
counterexamples.result: PASS: runtime_transition and freeze_scope explicitly defer IPC signatures, capability config, schema and mappings.

counterexamples.attempt: Treat a future cloud, named model/agent or server product as a Core dependency.
counterexamples.result: PASS: V1 confines them to optional adapters/future candidates.

counterexamples.attempt: Use the V1.0 promotion to mark Stage 4, risk closure, real-data access or engineering baseline restoration as passed.
counterexamples.result: PASS: the Task Contract and freeze_scope prohibit those promotions.
